# Flexpath Tax

Flexpath Tax is an Australian tax accounting and advisory practice serving individuals, contractors, freelancers, property investors and small businesses.

## Core Pages
- Home: https://flexpath.com.au/
- Services: https://flexpath.com.au/services
- About: https://flexpath.com.au/about
- Experience: https://flexpath.com.au/experience
- Blog: https://flexpath.com.au/blog
- Contact: https://flexpath.com.au/contact
- Chinese home: https://flexpath.com.au/zh/

## Services
- Personal tax returns
- Rental property tax
- Capital gains tax
- Business tax and compliance
- BAS, GST and PAYG support
- SMSF accounting and tax
- ATO correspondence and regulatory support
- Technology-enabled accounting workflows

## Notes
Website content is general information only and does not replace personal tax advice.
